Saving and data

9 calls on vupp.canvas, vupp.docs, vupp, vupp.store, generated from the firmware. Every one exists on the device exactly as written here.

The app's persisted, parent-visible state (docs/11-app-contract.md).

vupp.canvas.save

vupp.canvas.save(doc_key, payload [, rect{x,y,w,h}]) -> bool

capability: canvas

Captures the CURRENT app canvas (or the rect region, canvas coords) -> palette RGB565 -> 2x nearest-neighbor upscale (nicer viewing on phones) -> JPEG beside the document as {doc_key}.jpg -> docstore document {doc_type "drawing", payload, assets {"image":"{doc_key}.jpg"}, status "queued", origin "device"} -> doc.put sync job (uploads the JPEG, upserts the row). Re-saving the same key overwrites: the row id stays stable (like the store doc), so newest wins locally and in the cloud (409->PATCH path). Bad usage (oversized payload, bad key/rect) raises; I/O trouble returns false (logged) so a full SD can't crash the app mid-masterpiece.

#argument
1doc_keyrequired: key may not contain '/'
2payloadrequired
3rectoptional: rect outside the canvas
4 table fields, with defaults
xrequired
yrequired
wrequired
hrequired

vupp.docs.get

vupp.docs.get(doc_type, key) -> payload table | nil

One document from the app's own namespace. nil when there is no such key, and also when the key exists but holds a different doc_type.

#argument
1doc_typerequired
2keyrequired

vupp.docs.list

vupp.docs.list(doc_type) -> array of documents

Every document of that type in the app's own namespace, including the ones a parent pushed (origin tells them apart). Each entry is {key, doc_type, status, origin, payload}. Bounded to the newest 32, like the Messages screen.

#argument
1doc_typerequired

vupp.docs.of

vupp.docs.of(app_ref)

READ another app's documents (no isolation between apps by design, docs/11; writes stay in the own namespace).

#argument
1app_refrequired: app_ref must be 'system:{name}' or 'lib:{slug}'

vupp.docs.put

vupp.docs.put(doc_type, key, payload [, asset_path])

Upsert into the app's own namespace + queue the doc.put sync job.

#argument
1doc_typerequired: doc_type too long
2keyrequired: key may not contain '/'
3payloadrequired
4asset_pathoptional

vupp.on_command

vupp.on_command(fn)

Register fn(name, args) -> result table for the commands the manifest declares (docs/11-app-contract.md). The runtime handles acknowledgement and expiry; the app just answers.

#argument
1fnrequired

vupp.on_document

vupp.on_document(fn)

Register fn(doc) for documents the PARENT pushes while the app is running: a new colouring page, a word list, a photo. The runtime calls it; the app never does. doc has the same shape vupp.docs.list returns.

#argument
1fnrequired

Key was never written.

#argument
1keyrequired
2defaultoptional

vupp.store.set

vupp.store.set(key, value)

Value is nil | bool | number | string | small table. Sugar over a single 'store' document underneath, so a high score is parent-visible like everything else and survives both leaving the app and reinstalling it. It also survives an edit, which is worth remembering while testing a "best score".

The WHOLE store has to serialize into one document payload, so the size check happens on the write rather than at flush time: an oversized value is rolled back and raises, instead of quietly losing the save later. "store" is a reserved document key. Keep it to a high score or the furthest level; this is a save file, not a database.

#argument
1keyrequired
